subject: A custom Google Business Profile growth plan for ABC Dental Studio
title: Google Business Profile Growth Plan
subtitle: More local patients. More booked chairs. Less guesswork.
preparedFor: ABC Dental Studio — Dr. Avery Brown
serviceTitle: Google Business Profile Optimization — Monthly Growth Package
executiveSummary: ABC Dental Studio has a real opportunity to capture more nearby patients searching for a trusted dentist on Google. FlowSmartly will rebuild and continuously optimize your Google Business Profile, strengthen local trust signals, and turn search visibility into booked appointments. We handle the posts, reviews, citations, geotagging, and reporting so your front desk can focus on patients. This is a month-to-month engagement with transparent reporting and clear next steps every week.
aboutBrand: FlowSmartly is an AI-powered growth platform built for local businesses. We combine brand-aware content, automation, and local listing workflows to deliver measurable results — not vanity metrics. Our team has helped dental, medical, and service brands climb into Google's local 3-pack and stay there.
clientNeed: Patients searching for a dentist nearby rarely scroll past the top three Google map results. To win those clicks, calls, and bookings, ABC Dental Studio needs a fully optimized profile, fresh weekly content, steady review velocity, and consistent citations across the web. This package handles all of it.
commitments: Full audit and rebuild of your Google Business Profile
Keyword-rich service descriptions tailored to dental search intent
Weekly Google posts featuring services, offers, and patient education
Geotagged photos of your studio, team, and treatments
Review request workflows and response management
Citation building and cleanup across 40+ local directories
Monthly competitor and local ranking analysis
Conversion tracking for calls, direction requests, and bookings
Dedicated account manager and shared reporting portal
Responses to client feedback within one business day
benefits: Higher visibility in Google's local 3-pack for dental searches
More phone calls and appointment requests from nearby patients
Stronger online reputation through consistent 5-star reviews
Improved trust signals with verified information and fresh photos
Better conversion of profile views into booked chairs
Consistent presence across maps, search, and voice queries
Time saved — your team focuses on patients, not listings
Clear monthly proof of what's working and what's next
Lower cost-per-patient compared to paid ads
Compounding local SEO equity month over month

deliverables.title: Profile Optimization
deliverables.description: Complete rebuild of categories, services, attributes, hours, descriptions, and Q&A using dental-focused keywords.

deliverables.title: Weekly Google Posts
deliverables.description: 4–5 branded posts per month highlighting services, offers, patient tips, and seasonal campaigns.

deliverables.title: Review Management
deliverables.description: Automated review requests after appointments plus professional responses to every new review.

deliverables.title: Geotagged Photo Library
deliverables.description: Monthly upload of geotagged photos of the studio, team, and treatments to boost local relevance.

deliverables.title: Citations & Backlinks
deliverables.description: Submission and cleanup of business listings across 40+ directories for NAP consistency.

deliverables.title: Reporting Portal
deliverables.description: Live dashboard tracking rankings, calls, direction requests, website clicks, and bookings.

terms: Month-to-month engagement. Cancel anytime after the first 30 days.
Activation begins once profile access and onboarding details are received.
Client provides Google Business Profile access, service details, photos, and timely approvals.
First posts and optimizations go live within 7–10 business days of onboarding.
Performance results vary based on competition, market, and review velocity — outcomes are not guaranteed.
Monthly reports delivered within the first 5 business days of each cycle.
Refunds are not issued for completed monthly work; cancellations apply to the next billing cycle.
Delays caused by missing client information or third-party platforms may extend timelines.
